escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: An aggregate is reconstructed from a limited page of mixed child events, so the durable root disappears after enough legitimate children and the system silently starts a new aggregate.

literal_case.evidence: Persistence fixture crosses 20 extension events; reconciliation retains original startedAt and exactly one grandfathered-start fact.

sibling_cases.evidence: Root lookup is direct and independent of child count.
A 21st explicit decision extends the same durable window by exactly 30 days.

prevention_change.skill_or_code: durable aggregate reconstruction plus generic delivery control
prevention_change.evidence: Root event is loaded directly; generic EVENT-HISTORY-LIVENESS-001 prevention rule and transfer tests passed.

detection_change.skill_or_gate: persistence regression plus independent-audit history-boundary attack
detection_change.evidence: Expanded TiDB scenario and generic detection contract cover history beyond page boundaries.

escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: A retry key is derived from post-effect mutable state, so repeating the same business decision computes a new key and applies the effect again.

literal_case.evidence: Same decisionId retried after the first effect returns the persisted startsAt/endsAt and leaves one extension fact.

sibling_cases.evidence: Two concurrent calls with one decisionId converge to one persisted extension.
A distinct decisionId creates exactly one new 30-day block.

prevention_change.skill_or_code: stable decision identity plus generic delivery control
prevention_change.evidence: Extension command now requires decisionId; generic DECISION-IDEM-001 prevention rule and transfer tests passed.

detection_change.skill_or_gate: sequential/concurrent persistence regression plus independent-audit decision-identity attack
detection_change.evidence: Expanded TiDB scenario and generic detection contract distinguish retry from a new decision.
